create_embedding_engine: create an sglang Engine with is_embedding=True to generate text embeddings from a model
encode_prompts_embeddings: encode a list of text prompts into embedding vectors using sglang Engine.encode()
run_embedding_inference: run embedding inference on sample prompts using sglang Engine with a GTE model
build_embedding_pipeline: build an embedding pipeline that encodes multiple text prompts and prints resulting vectors
test_embedding_output: test the sglang Engine.encode() method returns embedding vectors for each input prompt
